record.bible_text: <FO><FO><FI> A Psalm<Fi> of David<WH01732>.<Fo><Fo> Plead<WH07378><WTH8798> <FI>my cause<Fi> , O LORD<WH03068>, with them that strive<WH03401> with me: fight<WH03898><WTH8798> against them that fight<WH03898><WTH8802> against me.
Take hold<WH02388><WTH8685> of shield<WH04043> and buckler<WH06793>, and stand up<WH06965><WTH8798> for mine help<WH05833>.

Draw out<WH07324><WTH8685> also the spear<WH02595>, and stop<WH05462><WTH8798> <FI>the way<Fi> against<WH07125><WTH8800> them that persecute<WH07291><WTH8802> me: say<WH0559><WTH8798> unto my soul<WH05315>, I <FI>am<Fi> thy salvation<WH03444>.

Let them be confounded<WH0954><WTH8799> and put to shame<WH03637><WTH8735> that seek<WH01245><WTH8764> after my soul<WH05315>: let them be turned<WH05472><WTH8735> back<WH0268> and brought to confusion<WH02659><WTH8799> that devise<WH02803><WTH8802> my hurt<WH07451>.
Let them be as chaff<WH04671> before<WH06440> the wind<WH07307>: and let the angel<WH04397> of the LORD<WH03068> chase<WH01760><WTH8802> <FI>them<Fi> .
Let their way<WH01870> be dark<WH02822> and slippery<WH02519>: and let the angel<WH04397> of the LORD<WH03068> persecute<WH07291><WTH8802> them. <RF>dark...: Heb. darkness and slipperiness<Rf>

For without cause<WH02600> have they hid<WH02934><WTH8804> for me their net<WH07568> <FI>in<Fi> a pit<WH07845>, <FI>which<Fi> without cause<WH02600> they have digged<WH02658><WTH8804> for my soul<WH05315>.

Let destruction<WH07722> come<WH0935><WTH8799> upon him at unawares<WH03045><WTH8799><WH03808>; and let his net<WH07568> that he hath hid<WH02934><WTH8804> catch<WH03920><WTH8799> himself: into that very destruction<WH07722> let him fall<WH05307><WTH8799>. <RF>at...: Heb. which he knoweth not of<Rf>
And my soul<WH05315> shall be joyful<WH01523><WTH8799> in the LORD<WH03068>: it shall rejoice<WH07797><WTH8799> in his salvation<WH03444>.

All my bones<WH06106> shall say<WH0559><WTH8799>, LORD<WH03068>, who <FI>is<Fi> like unto thee, which deliverest<WH05337><WTH8688> the poor<WH06041> from him that is too strong<WH02389> for him, yea, the poor<WH06041> and the needy<WH034> from him that spoileth<WH01497><WTH8802> him?<CM>

False<WH02555> witnesses<WH05707> did rise up<WH06965><WTH8799>; they laid to my charge<WH07592><WTH8799> <FI>things<Fi> that I knew<WH03045><WTH8804> not. <RF>False...: Heb. Witnesses of wrong<Rf> <RF>they...: Heb. they asked me<Rf>
They rewarded<WH07999><WTH8762> me evil<WH07451> for good<WH02896> <FI>to<Fi> the spoiling<WH07908> of my soul<WH05315>. <RF>spoiling: Heb. depriving<Rf>

But as for me, when they were sick<WH02470><WTH8800>, my clothing<WH03830> <FI>was<Fi> sackcloth<WH08242>: I humbled<WH06031><WTH8765> my soul<WH05315> with fasting<WH06685>; and my prayer<WH08605> returned<WH07725><WTH8799> into mine own bosom<WH02436>. <RF>humbled: or, afflicted<Rf>

I behaved<WH01980><WTH8694> myself as though <FI>he had been<Fi> my friend<WH07453> <FI>or<Fi> brother<WH0251>: I bowed down<WH07817><WTH8804> heavily<WH06937><WTH8802>, as one that mourneth<WH057> <FI>for his<Fi> mother<WH0517>. <RF>behaved myself: Heb. walked<Rf> <RF>as though...: Heb. as a friend, as a brother to me<Rf>

But in mine adversity<WH06761> they rejoiced<WH08055><WTH8804>, and gathered themselves together<WH0622><WTH8738>: <FI>yea<Fi> , the abjects<WH05222> gathered themselves together<WH0622><WTH8738> against me, and I knew<WH03045><WTH8804> <FI>it<Fi>  not; they did tear<WH07167><WTH8804> <FI>me<Fi> , and ceased<WH01826><WTH8804> not: <RF>adversity: Heb. halting<Rf>
With hypocritical<WH02611> mockers<WH03934> in feasts<WH04580>, they gnashed<WH02786><WTH8800> upon me with their teeth<WH08127>.<CM>

Lord<WH0136>, how long wilt thou look on<WH07200><WTH8799>? rescue<WH07725><WTH8685> my soul<WH05315> from their destructions<WH07722>, my darling<WH03173> from the lions<WH03715>. <RF>darling: Heb. only one<Rf>
I will give thee thanks<WH03034><WTH8686> in the great<WH07227> congregation<WH06951>: I will praise<WH01984><WTH8762> thee among much<WH06099> people<WH05971>. <RF>much: Heb. strong<Rf>

Let not them that are mine enemies<WH0341><WTH8802> wrongfully<WH08267> rejoice<WH08055><WTH8799> over me: <FI>neither<Fi> let them wink<WH07169><WTH8799> with the eye<WH05869> that hate<WH08130><WTH8802> me without a cause<WH02600>. <RF>wrongfully: Heb. falsely<Rf>
For they speak<WH01696><WTH8762> not peace<WH07965>: but they devise<WH02803><WTH8799> deceitful<WH04820> matters<WH01697> against <FI>them that are<Fi> quiet<WH07282> in the land<WH0776>.
Yea, they opened their mouth<WH06310> wide<WH07337><WTH8686> against me, <FI>and<Fi> said<WH0559><WTH8804>, Aha<WH01889>, aha<WH01889>, our eye<WH05869> hath seen<WH07200><WTH8804> <FI>it<Fi> .
<FI> This<Fi> thou hast seen<WH07200><WTH8804>, O LORD<WH03068>: keep not silence<WH02790><WTH8799>: O Lord<WH0136>, be not far<WH07368><WTH8799> from me.
Stir up<WH05782><WTH8685> thyself, and awake<WH06974><WTH8685> to my judgment<WH04941>, <FI>even<Fi> unto my cause<WH07379>, my God<WH0430> and my Lord<WH0136>.
Judge<WH08199><WTH8798> me, O LORD<WH03068> my God<WH0430>, according to thy righteousness<WH06664>; and let them not rejoice<WH08055><WTH8799> over me.

Let them not say<WH0559><WTH8799> in their hearts<WH03820>, Ah<WH01889>, so would we have it<WH05315>: let them not say<WH0559><WTH8799>, We have swallowed him up<WH01104><WTH8765>. <RF>Ah...: Heb. Ah, ah, our soul<Rf>

Let them be ashamed<WH0954><WTH8799> and brought to confusion<WH02659><WTH8799> together<WH03162> that rejoice<WH08056> at mine hurt<WH07451>: let them be clothed<WH03847><WTH8799> with shame<WH01322> and dishonour<WH03639> that magnify<WH01431><WTH8688> <FI>themselves<Fi> against me.

Let them shout for joy<WH07442><WTH8799>, and be glad<WH08055><WTH8799>, that favour<WH02655> my righteous cause<WH06664>: yea, let them say<WH0559><WTH8799> continually<WH08548>, Let the LORD<WH03068> be magnified<WH01431><WTH8799>, which hath pleasure<WH02655> in the prosperity<WH07965> of his servant<WH05650>. <RF>righteous...: Heb. righteousness<Rf>
And my tongue<WH03956> shall speak<WH01897><WTH8799> of thy righteousness<WH06664> <FI>and<Fi> of thy praise<WH08416> all the day<WH03117> long.<CM>
